titleEn: Sync templates and review status from Meta

en: My template status did not update, how do I sync?

steps: API only: no caller in web or cron (no periodic sync)
Status also updates via webhook message_template_status_update
edgeCases: Meta unreachable or rate-limited: 503 rate_limited, retry shortly; nothing is lost
gaps: NO caller (audit #2): nothing triggers sync on connect or periodically
Staff may call it (no owner check)
assistantNote: full replace: absent templates are deleted locally
